open_questions: Do qualified LLM workers use the delivered evidence to improve verified task outcomes on fresh tasks? (Partly answered November 1: a bank of verified records raised first-try verification from 24 to 39 of 40 across three cycles on fixture tasks; the open part is fresh, non-fixture tasks.)

Does narrowing then deepening on surviving leads beat narrowing alone at matched budget? (The comparison stopped at its budget cap before any deep cell opened; a hard task family where the frontier model alone verifies 2 of 12 now exists for it.)
Can a recurrent-depth ('think longer') worker verify a typed path at all? (0 of 12 at depths 4, 8 and 16; deep cells stay frontier-only until it does.)
Does the layout generalize beyond this admitted corpus construction?
What is the packing ratio beyond three circuits, and how does IBM partition a 1,200-circuit request internally?
Does the one-job mission hold on ibm_kingston after a fresh calibration (the cancelled J11 attempt)?

Settled November 2: IBM finalized the two reserved attempts (0 s and 5 s of the 40 s reserved) about 13 hours after each job ended, and the ledger released or settled each row on that job-specific evidence. Open: how long provider accounting takes in general, and how to size reservations for stopped jobs.
How should receipt-size limits, key management and production admission support packed hardware requests?
How can validated source-accounting and semantic retention be integrated into System2 callers?
Can complete worker isolation and full production dispatch be demonstrated?

Can a frontier weight-space programmer repair one reproducible failure of a 0.8-billion-parameter local model, judged on unseen tasks with no adjacent regression? (Harness built and reviewed November 3; an offline rehearsal with a fake model promoted one patch and rejected the repeat; NOT RUN on the real model.)

What does a self-hosted open model cost per verified record on a rented GPU? (Modelled only: the gateway mid-cost model is cheaper per verified at dated H100 rates, and the hosted options have no measured verified rate; one preregistered rental is the next step and has not run; 0 GPU hours.)

Does a full three-lane cycle run with hardware delivery inside it? (No cycle has yet run with the IBM step inside it; the 400-agent rung is modelled at 4 IBM jobs of about 20 s from the measured 5 s one-job mission, and the packets have only been exercised offline through the same codec.)

Does the comm-ops bus carry a mission's hand-offs at lower token cost without changing outcomes? (SB-3 NOT RUN: 80 qualifying hand-offs where the rule needs 100; the other three shadow-mode gates MET.)

Can a frontier model's small weight patch lower the stop-at-goal student's length-cap rate while keeping its correct answers? (O8 built, not run: no GPU capacity on November 8; three rounds so far taught the answer convention but every version looped more than the base.)
